title: Wind Penalty on Scooter Efficiency
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=scooter:trip
| eval km_per_pct=round(distance_km/battery_used_pct,2)
| stats avg(km_per_pct) as avg_efficiency, avg(wind_kph) as avg_wind, count as trips by wind_bucket
| sort wind_bucket
description: Shows how much headwind is costing you in scooter efficiency.
value: Knowing the wind penalty helps set realistic battery expectations and route choices.
implementation: Capture trip distance, battery used, and wind bucket in `index=personal`; compare efficiency by wind condition.
visualization: Bar chart of scooter efficiency by wind bucket.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how much windy conditions cut into your scooter range, so battery anxiety gets replaced with real data.
